Contact - Hurleys
Contact us
Hurley’s Irish Pub
Our famous flagship location
1225 Crescent Street  Montreal, Quebec  514.861.4111* 
Instagram @hurleysirishpub
 *Please note that during peak times the phone is unlikely to be answered. 
Better to drop by and chat over a pint instead! Or just use the form below. 😉
Hurley’s YUL
Pierre Trudeau Airport (two locations)
Gate 52, International
Gate 81, United States
Enjoy our famous friendliness, delicious fare, and North America’s best pint of Guinness while on your way in or out of Montreal.
Contact Us
Our flagship location in downtown Montreal, on three floors with a cozy historic ambiance, multiple interior and exterior areas and music seven nights a week.
